meta.title: Tactical Briefing Boot
meta.description: A four-beat holographic mission-briefing opening. The theater reveal settles the map first, then a solid white-hot point stays fixed while a translucent dome expands in place around it and dense rays burst outward; the magenta sector fill rises from below, the rays and dome dissipate, leaving only the key nodes. Holographic command-table uplink, operator access / systems check and a mission-start title complete the sequence. The map and HUD are drawn in code; Agnes generates only the terrain relief and holographic table plates. About 15 seconds, skippable, played once per application start.
